title: What to look for when evaluating a new AI tool
summary: Assess task fit, data handling, accuracy, integration, governance and total cost before adopting a tool.

title: Give AI context before asking for an answer
summary: Share the goal, audience, source information, constraints and expected output format to improve relevance.

title: Build your first reusable AI Skill
summary: Define a repeatable task, document the steps, add examples and test the result against real inputs.

title: Ask AI to show its assumptions
summary: Request missing information, assumptions and uncertainty instead of accepting a confident-sounding answer.

title: Prompt, Skill, Tool and Workflow: what is the difference?
summary: Understand how instructions, reusable procedures, connected capabilities and business processes work together.

title: Responsible AI starts with responsible data
summary: Use approved tools, minimize sensitive inputs and review privacy, security and intellectual-property implications.
